text:
Three small patties, which look like breakfast sausage patties, sit on a square plate. I used the plate as a ruler.

The plate is about 340 px across in the image. If it is a side-plate size of roughly 22 cm, that gives about 0.065 cm per px.

Each patty is about 85 px across, which is roughly 5.5 cm. The patties are about 1.2 cm thick.

Volume of one patty is π × 2.75² × 1.2, or about 28 cm³. At a density near 0.95 g/cm³ that is roughly 27 g. Three patties come to about 80 g, and I reduced that slightly to 75 g.

Cooked sausage patties run about 300 kcal per 100 g.
